about.storyText: Yafet was born from a simple belief: that every Ethiopian home deserves access to world-class bedding. Founded in Addis Ababa, we've spent years sourcing the finest materials from across the globe—Mulberry silk from China, Egyptian cotton from the Nile Valley, and velvet weaves from Italian artisans.
